chunks: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Hamadani narrated to us, saying: Isma'il ibn al-Fadl narrated to us, saying: Sakhtawih ibn Shabib al-Bahili narrated to us, saying: Asim narrated from Isma'il ibn Sulayman al-Taymi, from Abu Uthman al-Nahdi, from Salman al-Farisi, who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'There is no servant who prays six rak'at on the night of Eid except that he will be granted intercession for all members of his family, even if Hellfire had been decreed for them.' They asked: 'Why is this, O Messenger of Allah?' He replied: 'Because the virtuous do not need intercession; intercession is only for every one who is perishing.'
And Muhammad ibn al-Husayn said: One should recite 'Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad' five times in each rak'at.

key_terms.قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ: Say: He is Allah, the One (Surah Al-Ikhlas)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward of praying six rakat on the night of Eid and how does intercession work for family members?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the Shia concept of *shafa'ah* (intercession) as a divine mercy extended to the families of the righteous, distinguishing it from the self-sufficiency of the virtuous who require no intercession. The specific practice of reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas five times per rak'ah underscores the theological weight of divine unity (*Tawhid*) in securing this spiritual benefit. It reflects the broader Shia understanding that intercession is not arbitrary but operates within the framework of God's justice and mercy.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) says, “One who offers a six rakat Salaat on the eve of Eid would be able to intercede for all  members  of  his  family  even  if  they  be  condemned  to Hell.” The narrator asked, “O Messenger of Allah! Why will the   intercession   of  sinners   be  accepted?”  He   replied, “Virtuous do not need intercession. They are sinners who need it much.”
Muhammad  bin  Husain  (Shaykh  Sadooq)  says  that  one should recite Surah Tauheed five times in each rakat of the above-mentioned prayer.
